purpose: Exploratory fixed-budget structural pruning and fine-tuning comparison; no final-evaluation selection
candidate_rule: Keep 12 of 16 last-decoder channels with largest absolute final output weights, with index tie-break; no evaluation-set tuning
selection: Use tuning data only; do not use final validation set for model selection.
limitation: Only 16 training samples in one scene and 16 tuning samples in a second scene. Exact decoded RGB overlap with local evaluation was checked; near-duplicates and evaluation scene identities remain unknown. Not an Orin-aware optimization or generalization study.
